items.name: Amane Trig
items.title: Intelligent Road Safety
items.description: Amane Trig is an AI-powered road safety device designed to monitor driver behaviour and the road environment in real time.

features.title: Dual AI dashcam
features.description: Two cameras continuously record the road and the driver; the AI analyses the footage inside the vehicle.

features.title: Behaviour analysis
features.description: Detection of risky driver behaviour: distraction, fatigue, phone use.

features.title: Web platform
features.description: A dashboard to follow trips, events and indicators for every vehicle.

features.title: Real-time alerts
features.description: Immediate audible and visual warnings when danger arises, also reported on the platform.

items.dashboardAltText: Illustrative preview of the Amane Trig web platform: a driving score of 87 out of 100, a breakdown of driving time and an alert about insufficient safety distance.

detail.tagline: An electronic co-pilot that watches both the road and the driver, turning every trip into usable data.
detail.longDescription: Amane Trig is a next-generation road safety system that uses artificial intelligence to analyse driver behaviour and the road environment in real time. With a dual smart dashcam and an advanced web platform, Amane Trig helps companies significantly reduce accidents, improve their drivers' performance and protect their vehicles, while lowering the operating costs tied to road risk.
